US Homeland Security Secretary Removed from TV Appearances

US Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin has reportedly been removed from television appearances by White House Chief of Staff Stephen Miller following a series of public messaging errors. One Fox News interview reportedly triggered this decision, frustrating senior Trump administration officials. Mullin had also testified before Congress after nationwide tech outages.
